summary: Backend integration testing for LUMIASIGN ERP completed. All 36 pytest tests passed (100%) covering auth, dashboard, leads, quotations, projects, production, materials, stock-movements, purchases, installations, costs, profit-analysis, reports, and RBAC.

minor.issue: PUT update_quotation persists items as list of dicts already (since pydantic), but if client sends partial body without items, it overwrites items to []; consider supporting partial updates (not part of stated requirements).
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True - browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Currently no production cookies so not blocking, but should be tightened.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~980 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, projects, inventory, finance) for maintainability.

Quotation/Project/Purchase numbering uses count_documents() which is NOT concurrency-safe (race condition can yield duplicate quote_no / project_no / po_no). Use atomic counter collection or unique index + retry.
Project deletion does not cascade-delete production_jobs / installations / purchases referencing it (only costs). Possible orphan records.
Stock movement on 'out' lacks audit of who performed it (no user_id stored on movement/lead/project/etc.).
/api/installations PUT does not revert project status when status changes from 'completed' back to 'scheduled' (edge case).
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER include_router; works in Starlette but conventionally added before.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers (Starlette warning).
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md - admin@lumiasign.com/admin123 and 5 role accounts with lumia123. All authenticate correctly.
seed_data_creation: Seed runs on startup; verified 7 materials, 4 leads, 5 projects with computed costs are present. Tests create TEST_ prefixed data and clean it up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. Use /app/backend/tests/test_lumiasign_erp.py as regression suite. All endpoints work, RBAC enforced (admin bypass works, role-specific 403 for unauthorized roles). Bcrypt $2b$ format confirmed. JWT 7-day expiry. No httpOnly cookies are used - this is Bearer-token based auth (acceptable for ERP per requirements; playbook httpOnly cookie check is not applicable here).
